output.one_liner: Apify is a cloud platform for developing, running, and sharing Actors—serverless microapps for web scraping, data extraction, and automation.

auth.notes: API token authentication using Bearer tokens in Authorization header; bearer_token is static API key sent as Bearer token.

evidence.snippet: Add the token to your request's Authorization header as Bearer <token>.

access.notes: Free account creation with $500 worth of free usage included; free tier available for API access; pay-per-run pricing for published Actors.

evidence.snippet: Create a free account. No credit card required.
Enjoy $500 worth of free usage to build your own Actors along with other benefits for 6 months.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Pagination enforced; maximum limit values documented per endpoint and subject to change.

evidence.snippet: The API is organized around RESTful HTTP endpoints.
You can download the complete OpenAPI schema of Apify API in the YAML or JSON formats.
Webhooks allow you to configure the Apify platform to perform an action when a certain system event occurs.
The Apify's MCP server (mcp.apify.com) allows AI applications and agents to interact with the Apify platform using Model Context Protocol (MCP).

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free credentials, well-documented REST API with OpenAPI spec, official MCP server, and existing Composio toolkit with 185 tools already deployed.

overview_evidence.snippet: Apify is all about Actors—a new way to package your code to make it easy to share, integrate, and build upon.
Develop, run, and share web scraping and automation tools in the cloud.
